summary: The same restricted launch with no --tools list has no shell at all: the session reported 'Agent, Edit, Glob, Grep, ListAgents, Read, ReportFindings, ScheduleWakeup, Skill, ToolSearch, Write' and answered 'no shell tool exists' to both command questions, while the in-root read still succeeded.
establishes: The mechanism behind #153's observation, and that the observation was about the launch shape rather than the flag: --restricted removes the code-running tools unless --tools names them, which this runtime's own --help states and this probe confirms. Read with P15a, the pair fixes the cause and closes gap-9's headline hazard.
residual: A second, unbudgeted-for finding: without an explicit --tools list this runtime also hands the session Skill, ToolSearch, ScheduleWakeup, ListAgents and ReportFindings, which the frozen shape's --tools list excludes. A cell launched without --tools would carry a skill loader the freeze never specified, so the explicit --tools list is load-bearing for arm comparability and not decoration.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
